CapabilityBinding.description:
Concrete adapter connection of a capability (owner: workspace).

An approved ticket does not make a binding ready: ``ready`` needs a verification time.
CapabilityBinding.title: CapabilityBinding

CapabilityManifest.description:
Discoverable description of an existing workspace.Capability (owner: workspace).

``instructions`` is data for the agent's choice of method, never an operator command.
CapabilityManifest.title: CapabilityManifest

CapabilityRequest.description: What a capability ticket asks for; text and approval never grant it by themselves.
CapabilityRequest.title: CapabilityRequest

FileWrite.description:
Request to the file owner. Content bytes travel beside it, checked by digest/size.

``expected_version`` None creates; otherwise it is the CAS precondition.
``declared_sources`` can only add dependencies to those of the attempt.
FileWrite.title: FileWrite

GmRuntimeState.description: GM-owned configuration and conservative active-time checkpoint.
GmRuntimeState.title: GmRuntimeState

HelperRun.description: Owner receipt in an attempt; prepared/unknown execution is never replayed blindly.
HelperRun.title: HelperRun

ManagedFile.description:
Catalogue entry of one version of a workplace file; content is addressed by reference.

``dependencies`` is the complete, conservative source set assigned by the trusted file or
context service. Expired/deleted/unavailable sources block the file, they are not dropped.
ManagedFile.title: ManagedFile

MemoryCorrection.description: Operator annotation; inherits the record's source rights and retention dependencies.
MemoryCorrection.title: MemoryCorrection

MemoryCycle.description: Bounded processing receipt. IDs/status only; it does not retain raw or derived text.
MemoryCycle.title: MemoryCycle

MemoryPlanProof.description: Text-free owner proof; it must remain readable while the source is being purged.
MemoryPlanProof.title: MemoryPlanProof

PermissionConditions.description: ``workplace.permission-conditions`` of a workplace Permission: scope of the decision.
PermissionConditions.title: PermissionConditions

PermissionDecisionArguments.description:
A structured operator decision on one capability right; never parsed from ticket text.

``grant`` answers an exact ticket version and creates or replaces the right; ``revoke``
names the exact current permission version. Both go preview → execute.
PermissionDecisionArguments.title: PermissionDecisionArguments

PermissionDecisionProof.description: Workspace-owner proof of a previewed decision; execute rechecks every pinned version.
PermissionDecisionProof.title: PermissionDecisionProof

PermissionLimits.description: ``workplace.permission-limits``: the granted duration, bounded by the host ceiling.
PermissionLimits.title: PermissionLimits

PrivateApiStatus.description: Safe private-dialogue admission counter, not a monetary cost or permission grant.
PrivateApiStatus.title: PrivateApiStatus

PromiseCloseArguments.description:
The operator closes an exact promise; the history keeps every earlier version.

`fulfilled` is grounded by the operator's own stated result (a new operator source), never
by the character's reply; `withdrawn` needs a reason; `unknown` keeps it owed.
PromiseCloseArguments.title: PromiseCloseArguments

ReflectionCheckpoint.description: Persona-owned validated model result; restart never invents a second proposal.
ReflectionCheckpoint.title: ReflectionCheckpoint

SessionReplyRef.description: An undelivered draft owned by Gateway/Channel, never a remembered message.
SessionReplyRef.title: SessionReplyRef

SettingsTransferOperation.description: Workspace-owned progress across distinct settings owners; never implies atomicity.
SettingsTransferOperation.title: SettingsTransferOperation

SkillVersion.description:
A method of using existing capabilities; it never adds tools, rights or schedules.

``uses_capabilities`` is descriptive; execution is still checked against permissions.
``verified`` needs evidence of a confirmed result, not the model's confidence.
SkillVersion.title: SkillVersion

Ticket.description: Durable conversation about one question; not a Job, ResourceTicket or person.
Ticket.title: Ticket

TicketMessage.description: Immutable message; ``ticket_version`` is the ticket revision it produced.
TicketMessage.title: TicketMessage

TicketReplyArguments.description:
Operator message on an exact ticket version; ``answer`` hands the turn to the agent.

``resolve``/``close`` end the ticket with this text as the resolution; a later answer or
agent recurrence reopens it. Nothing here grants a right: that is a separate decision.
TicketReplyArguments.title: TicketReplyArguments

ToolStep.description:
One finished tool call of a turn, as the harness observed it (clipped journal).

An observation for the operator and the next turn; never a receipt, right or result.
ToolStep.title: ToolStep

WakeTimer.description:
A wake-up the agent set for itself (W7): data, no right, no start after restart.

The platform fires it only while the run is active and autonomous, outside quiet hours
and within the hourly cap; firing appends a ``wake`` message to its session.
WakeTimer.title: WakeTimer

WorkAbandonArguments.description: The operator stops pursuing one task; the exact task version is the command's pin.
WorkAbandonArguments.title: WorkAbandonArguments

WorkAssignArguments.description: An operator's assignment; it is stored as a task and runs only after an explicit START.
WorkAssignArguments.title: WorkAssignArguments

WorkAttempt.description:
One task step or conversation turn, bound to exactly one job operation.

``inputs``/``input_files`` are recorded by the trusted context service when the attempt is
prepared; result dependencies are derived from them and cannot be removed by the executor.
``state`` reconciles from the job's ExecutionResult; ``unknown`` needs reconciliation
before any retry with an external effect.
WorkAttempt.title: WorkAttempt

WorkSessionEntry.description:
One message of a work conversation as the panel may show it (R3).

``text`` comes from the memory Source owner through the release gate; ``withheld`` means
its source is revoked, expired, deleted or blocked, and no text is given.
WorkSessionEntry.title: WorkSessionEntry

WorkSessionMessage.description: One ordered reference to a Source, not another private text/history copy.
WorkSessionMessage.title: WorkSessionMessage

WorkSessionMessageArguments.description: Operator text only. Identity, source and sequence are assigned by trusted owners.
WorkSessionMessageArguments.title: WorkSessionMessageArguments

WorkSessionModelCalls.description: Confirmed model calls of the current turn, from the LLM journal: counts and time only.
WorkSessionModelCalls.title: WorkSessionModelCalls

WorkSessionProgress.description:
Read-only state of the conversation's current turn from SessionBook, WorkAttempt and Job.

``waiting_start``: a stored message waits for an explicit START; ``queued``: accepted or
waiting for its turn; ``running``: its job runs; ``reply_ready``: a draft waits for
delivery; ``done``: the turn succeeded; ``failed``/``cancelled``/``unknown``: it ended
without a reply (``unknown``: the outcome is not confirmed). ``since`` is a recorded time,
never a timer. ``error_code`` only when the owner recorded one.
WorkSessionProgress.title: WorkSessionProgress

WorkSessionResultFile.description: A file the turn actually saved through the file owner (title and logical path only).
WorkSessionResultFile.title: WorkSessionResultFile

WorkSessionTranscript.description: A bounded tail of one work conversation; ``complete`` is false if older ones are cut.
WorkSessionTranscript.title: WorkSessionTranscript

WorkStep.description:
One finished tool step of a task, as the activity owner recorded it.

``read_*`` is what the step actually read: later attempts of the task carry it as inputs,
so a file written from it keeps the lineage. ``written`` are the files it produced.
WorkStep.title: WorkStep

WorkTask.description: Semantic goal, separate from any execution attempt. Never runs on its own.
WorkTask.title: WorkTask

WorkplaceFileContent.description:
The text of one catalogued file for the operator, through the file owner's guard.

``withheld`` means a basis of the file is revoked, expired, deleted or blocked, or the file
is not text: no content is given. Long text is cut and marked ``truncated``.
WorkplaceFileContent.title: WorkplaceFileContent

WorkplaceLibrary.title: WorkplaceLibrary
